# Stats & ADR — Technical Reference

Two small layout-only MDX components shipped together to complete the
planning-doc first-slice pitch (see `PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` §First-slice).
Neither has a data layer — they're pure JSX wrappers styled with
Tailwind + shadcn tokens + datagrid's `TONE_CLASS`.

- Package: `@filemark/mdx` (`packages/mdx-viewer/src/components/`)
- Files: `Stats.tsx`, `ADR.tsx`
- Showcase: `examples/stats-adr-full.md` (10 sections)
- Deps: zero new — reuses `@filemark/datagrid`'s `TONE_CLASS` + `StatusTone`.

---
